title: Reproduce and attribute shared-daemon handshake timeout under heavy index load
outcome: Determine why an accepted shared-daemon connection can exceed the frozen five-second authority handshake while a large index is loading, and fix the proven scheduling or transport cause without raising a timeout.
acceptance: A deterministic test reproduces the accepted-connection daemon_handshake_timeout under the proven load or scheduling condition, or evidence rules out Phoenix and identifies the external cause.
The proven root cause is fixed without introducing or raising a count, byte, or time limit, and the regression test passes.
